title: Welcome & motivation messages
hint: Shown full screen on every open board: now, at a set time, or daily at the same hour. You can add a photo, or your guests' logos.
bodyPlaceholder_welcome: A new day, new chances — good luck everyone
bodyPlaceholder_motivation: Every call today brings us closer to target
sentNow: Sent — the message is showing on open screens now.
empty: No messages yet. Start with a morning welcome.
bodyPlaceholder_guests: We're glad to host you at Everest today
bodyPlaceholder_newhire: Wishing you a great start and a career full of wins
imageType: The browser can't read this file as an image. Try JPG or PNG.
logosHint: A PNG with a transparent background looks cleanest. Logos sit on a light plaque; a single logo is shown beside the Everest logo.
spotlightHint: With a photo, the motivation message becomes a celebration stage: a large gold-framed photo with confetti, rays and sparkles. A cut-out photo stands at full height.
